newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: La Tondena falls 15.09 pct on H1 net news.
newsitem.headline: La Tondena falls 15.09 pct on H1 net news.

text.p: La Tondena Distillers Inc on Wednesday shed eight pesos, or 15.09 percent to 45 pesos in early trade on disappointing first half earnings, traders said.
BPI Securities Corp analyst Spencer Yap said La Tondena showed poor results in the second quarter due to sluggish sales.
La Tondena on Tuesday posted a 280 million peso net income against 220 million in the previous year.
"LTDI plans to improve sales in the second half through aggressive marketing promotions; however, it is unlikely that LTDI can make up for lost sales in the first half," said Yap.
Yap said he downgraded his full-year net income forecast for La Tondena to 776.2 million pesos from 1.01 billion.
"At 280 million pesos, the PE ratio of La Tondena is still 25 times. It's way above market, it's overvalued," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities Inc.
Liquor manufacturer La Tondena is a major contributor to San Miguel Corp's earnings.
The BPI official said he had to lower his net income projection for San Miguel to 5.62 billion pesos from 6.0 billion as a result of La Tondena's first half earnings.
